![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Pass `fallbackAccepted` to `receiptRef` so that the receipt status is correctly marked as `'accepted'` when the fallback is active, preventing validation failures.

```suggestion
    source_visual_receipt_ref: receiptRef(receiptInfo, paths, true, productionInfo, fallbackAccepted),
```
